statement: Plus Tr MP-only, kernel bound on Linux 6.12.113, is classified gen20 and has a MotionPlus evdev node. In one concurrent 18-second capture, all ABS_RX/RY/RZ axes and xwiimote MotionPlus events have two distinct driven values. This qualifies bounded software gyro delivery on this virtual Plus revision, not physical calibration, rates, all controls or decoded child acceptance. Exact-device owner-filtered kernel logs show detection but do not include inactive-ID hex; that byte-level kernel log observation remains unavailable.

applicability.revision: Tr / virtual Wii Remote Plus, Bluetooth PID 0330; physical revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Plus-specific kernel-bound software experiment at P1 code PR head; no Original inheritance. Source default built-in identity, caller synthetic calibration, no physical/radio/rate/game/challenge evidence. #258 release gate remains for special-driver windows.
